Before event classification, the leader and laggard-control arms must use opposite symbols, complete one round trip each, match entry and exit decision and fill timestamps, and preserve exactly 24 fill-to-fill bars. Any mismatch is terminal.

The four-worker spawned executor, stage barriers, one-claim workers, 300-second leases, 60-second heartbeats, create-only reports, three-attempt ceiling, and expired-no-result-only retry rule match existing controls.

June, V3, daily 2018-2019, PAPER and broker state, strategic-allocation-21, live execution, and partial-result adaptation remain unavailable. Implementation must merge separately and pass a finding-free exact-main launch review before the first reservation.
